bug.description: Startup against a stalled Postgres (lock held, or TCP accept with no reply) exits non-zero in about 6-7 s with "startup failed: Postgres unavailable: TimeoutError; ..." rather than the specified "startup failed: ... timed out" line. The 30 s DB_STARTUP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS branch is unreachable in these stalls because Database.connect() swallows the 5 s command/connect timeout into last_error (spec ambiguity 6 anticipated only the wait_for cancel path). Behaviour is safe (fails loudly, bounded, no secret leakage); only the wording differs from what was requested.
bug.reproduction: Create throwaway PG; in one session BEGIN; LOCK TABLE alert_rules IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE; then start uvicorn app.main:app with DATABASE_URL pointing at it. Or run scratchpad/drv/hole.py (listener on 55600 that never replies). Observe exit code 3 after about 6 s and the log lines above.

verification.self_critique: Not tested: the alert-writer/tick behaviour while the DB is locked (only after recovery), a hang between connect and DDL longer than 5 s per command (the only way to reach the 30 s limit), concurrent saturated-pool /health. The Windows timing numbers (5.05 s, 2.01 s) may differ on Linux/docker. The fake Finnhub ws is mine, not real Finnhub. Baseline copy ran with the pre-change fakes, as intended, but test_health_timeouts.py imports behaviour that did not exist so many failures are AttributeError-style rather than assertion failures. Overall FAIL is driven solely by the low-severity 3f wording item; everything else passed.
